To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the hollow double spherical interlayers and the submicron pores in the HPC@nano Si@GS composite can buffer the huge volume change during the charge/discharge processes, which is very important to improve the electrochemical properties.
the HPC@nano Si@GS microspherical anodes exhibit excellent electrochemical performance, with a high reversible capacity of 1405 mAh/g after 100 cycles at a current density of 0.2 A/g.
The nano-Si/C microspheres with a hollow double spherical structure and submicron pore are successfully synthesized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and preparation of nano-Si/C microspheres with submicron porous and hollow structure, which is of great importance in the field of lithium-ion battery anodes.
the preparation of nano-Si@graphite microspheres with submicron porous and hollow structure, which has a promising prospect in the field of high performance anode materials for lithium-ion battery.
the preparation of a novel nano-Si anode material with a unique structure and its electrochemical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HPC@nano Si@GS microspherical anode with submicron porous carbon and double spherical interlayer structure can be a promising candidate for high performance anode material for lithium ion battery.
the nano-Si@HPC@GS composite microspheres have the potential to be used in the field of high-performance anodes for lithium-ion batteries.
the HPC@nano-silicon@graphene microspheres have been successfully synthesized by a green and simple method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the HPC@nanoSi@GS microspheric anode materials with hollow porous carbon and submicron pores can realize the high capacity and stable cyclic stability, which is of great significance for practical application of nano-Si anodes.
HPC@nanoSi@GS microspheric structure can provide a new idea for the preparation of Si-based electrode materials with excellent performance.

the nano-Si@hollow porous carbon microsphere with sub-micron porous structure and graphene coating can be used as an anode material for lithium-ion batteries with excellent electrochemical performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hollow porous structure and graphene wrapping are effective to improve the cycling stability of Si anode for lithium-ion battery.
the HPC microspheres with submicron porous and the wrinkled graphene sheets are beneficial to improve the electrochemical performance of nano-Si for lithium-ion batteries anodes.
the hollow double spherical interlayers and submicron pores of HPC@GS microsphere can accommodate nano-Si particles very well, enhancing the cyclic performance and rate capacity.
